from stats import summarize, error_rate

def test_summarize_ignores_blank_lines():
    lines = [
        "2026-03-01 12:00:02 ERROR payments Card declined",
        "",
        "   ",
        "2026-03-01 12:00:03 INFO search Query served",
    ]
    assert summarize(lines) == {"ERROR": 1, "INFO": 1}

def test_error_rate_calculation():
    lines = [
        "2026-03-01 12:00:02 ERROR payments Card declined",
        "2026-03-01 12:00:03 INFO payments Success",
        "2026-03-01 12:00:04 INFO search Query served",
        "",
    ]
    # payments has 2 lines, 1 error -> 0.5
    assert error_rate(lines, "payments") == 0.5
    # search has 1 line, 0 errors -> 0.0
    assert error_rate(lines, "search") == 0.0
    # non-existent service has 0 lines -> 0.0
    assert error_rate(lines, "unknown") == 0.0
